entries.06252a9210d9fa05: The [Business Overview] states that the company analyzes and breaks down customers’ business flows to extract tasks that seniors can handle, that improved business flows can be deployed to customers’ competitors as similar cases, and that the company’s know-how accumulates as cases are added.

entries.13aa310e39e89734: A business that creates employment for people aged 55 and over who want to work, known as 'active seniors'.
entries.22fad1729611e7b8: A business that creates employment for people aged 55 and over who want to work, known as 'active seniors'. It analyzes clients' operations, separates tasks that seniors can perform, and provides staff dispatch, placement and operational contracting in fields such as building maintenance, bed making, office work and logistics. The business operates 8 branches nationwide, and revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,313 million.
entries.52cef361e4cc6cc5: It is a business model that dispatches and refers nursing care, medical and childcare professionals with qualifications, along with active senior personnel aged 55 and over who are willing to work, from 25 locations nationwide to customers, earning dispatch fees and referral fees.
entries.5539ee49f2dd3e2a: It provides the Senior Care Business, which dispatches and refers qualified personnel who support nursing care, and the Senior Work Business, which creates employment for seniors aged 55 and over.
entries.5dd69f8585acb106: In the Senior Work Business, the company will promote the creation of employment opportunities for active seniors through senior utilization consultants, and promote personnel referrals that draw on the experience and know-how of qualified active seniors.

entries.a6baaa32eacad4d1: Its customers are nursing care facilities, medical institutions and childcare facilities, as well as companies and government agencies that need personnel in building maintenance, logistics, call centers and other fields.
entries.c3d50f2a6880ca3a: In the Senior Work Business, the company will promote the creation of employment opportunities for active seniors through senior utilization consultants, and promote personnel referrals that draw on the experience and know-how of qualified active seniors. In the Senior Care Business, the company will continue dispatching and referring personnel who hold nursing qualifications, aims to develop care facility clients nationwide, and plans to grow through the dispatch and referral of care workers.
